end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
Matched dice, matchbox, bottle, birthday cap and ball to 3D shapes.
Described sphere as fully round with no corners and cylinder as having circular faces and a curved side.
Recognised that a cylinder stays the same shape when standing or lying down.
Spoon shape remained uncertain; no correction was recorded later.
end.parentNote: Asha practised shape names, everyday-object matching, and describing faces, corners and curved surfaces. Ishita explained why a matchbox is a cuboid and why a cylinder remains a cylinder in different positions. The spoon was a mix-up and was not corrected later (correctAfterLastSeen: false). At home, you can play a quick shape hunt using a ball, box, bottle and ice-cream cone, asking Ishita to name each shape and one feature.
